brand_notes: Acoustic Energy (UK) 100 Series Mk2 (AE100², AE109², AE120², AE105): HDF cabinets, WDT waveguide tweeter; AE100 Mk2 is the entry standmount at ~$499 US pair; 6 Ω; measured sensitivity well below claim (eac-acoustic-energy-ae100-mk2). AE120² is 8 Ω 3-way tower (mfr-acoustic-energy-ae100-mk2).
takeaways: Erin Klippel: LW ±2.0 dB, f3 64 Hz, sensitivity 83.6 dB vs 87 claimed
Min impedance 4.7 Ω (below IEC floor 4.8), EPDR 2.5 Ω
Directivity good but midrange dip 300-800 Hz and hot tweeter; Erin would pass without EQ
Other critics (StereoNET, ecoustics, HiFiReport) positive; amp and placement sensitive
No user reports ingested; US stock only loosely verified
log_bullets: Conflict: sensitivity 83.6 vs 87 claimed; woofer size sources disagree; US stock unverified
